district_name: Kingdom East Unified Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(D) inventory: Kingdom East Supervisory District -- the Kingdom East Unified Union School District is its own supervisory district (member towns: Burke, Concord, Lunenburg, Lyndon, Newark, Sheffield, Sutton, Wheelock). Formed July 1, 2018; operates PK-8 and tuitions grades 9-12.

sources.note: Kingdom East UUSD: fifteen directors, seats allocated by town residency -- Burke 2, Concord 2, Lunenburg 2, Lyndon 4, Newark 1, Sheffield 1, Sutton 2, Wheelock 1 (2026 Annual Report directory + warning) -- elected by the whole district electorate on a single commingled Australian ballot (16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2) modified at-large), so ONE 15-seat post. THIRTEEN members minted 2026-10-28 (the district was structure-only): the seven March 3, 2026 winners from the district's official results, plus the six continuing members the Annual Report directory lists without an '(Appointed)' mark, with its published ends (May 2028, Shine 2027, Carpenter 2028, Houghton 2028, J. Simpson 2027, Twombley 2027). The directory's 2025 appointees who stood in 2026 (D. Brown, Golden, Martin, Smith) are minted on their ELECTIONS; April Brown (appointed 2025, Sheffield) is not minted -- the Sheffield seat went to election in 2026 and Simons won it. Two seats are VACANT: the Lunenburg and Lyndon 1-year seats warned in 2026 went unfilled at the election (no write-in reached the 30-vote minimum); whether the board has since appointed to them is not documented in any fetched source.

Kingdom East UUSD official results page, 'Kingdom East FY27 Budget Results' (published 2026-03-09): Article 3, March 3, 2026 Australian ballot -- Amy McQuade ELECTED Burke, 3-year (write-in winner, 69 qualifying write-ins); Kurt Martin ELECTED Concord, 3-year (write-in, 59); Desmond Brown ELECTED Lunenburg, 3-year (785 yes); Lawrence Golden ELECTED Lyndon, 3-year (959 yes); Steve Smith ELECTED Lyndon, 2-year (867 yes); Bill Coleman ELECTED Newark, 3-year (852 yes); John W. Simons ELECTED Sheffield, 2-year (813 yes). The warned Lunenburg 1-year and Lyndon 1-year seats went UNFILLED (no write-in reached the 30-vote minimum) and remain vacant. The page's article header says 'Ten (10) school directors' but enumerates nine contests; the 2026 warning (revised 2/3/26, in the 2026 Annual Report) warns nine -- nine governs.

Kingdom East UUSD 2026 Annual Report (official): the Board Directory (p. 2, the pre-election roster) lists fifteen seats with towns and term expirations -- Burke: Alyssa May 2028, Abigail Montgomery 2026; Concord: Patricia Shine 2027, Kurt Martin (Appointed 2025) 2026; Lunenburg: Desmond Brown (Appointed 2025) 2027, James Peyton 2026; Lyndon: Lindsay Carpenter 2028, Larry Golden (Appointed 2025) 2027, Chad Simpson 2026, Steve Smith (Appointed 2025) 2028; Newark: seat vacant, expiring 2026; Sheffield: April Brown (Appointed 2025) 2028; Sutton: Candace Houghton 2028, Jake Simpson 2027; Wheelock: Norma Twombley 2027. Members the directory does NOT mark '(Appointed)' are carried as ELECTED. The same report's 2026 warning (pp. 31-32, revised 2/3/26) warns nine seats, matching the nine contests in the district's results. Carpenter signs the warning as Chair (Feb. 3, 2026) and the Board Report letter as School Board Chair.
